title: Super Walter conquers Europe! We have earned CE certification
seo_title: Super Walter conquers Europe: CE certification · News
seo_description: After a demanding audit and testing process, Super Walter machines meet European regulations. The gateway to the market of the old continent.
og_title: Super Walter conquers Europe: CE certification
hero_image_alt: Tractor with a Super Walter implement on a hillside
lead: Our machines meet European regulations. A huge step for exports and a validation of Argentine engineering.
body_paragraphs: After a demanding audit and testing process, our machines meet European regulations. It is the gateway to the market of the old continent and, above all, confirmation that the engineering we do in Las Parejas is up to any standard in the world.

CE certification backs the safety and manufacturing quality standards of our seeders, an essential requirement to offer them in Europe. Behind that seal are years of work by the entire technical team at Búfalo S.A.
We keep betting on taking Argentine engineering ever further, without losing the closeness to the local producers who saw us grow.
featured_desc: After a demanding audit and testing process, our machines meet European regulations. It is the gateway to the market of the old continent and, above all, confirmation that the engineering we do in Las Parejas is up to any standard in the world.

title: New intensive care units at the Las Parejas Hospital
seo_title: New intensive care units at the Las Parejas Hospital · News
seo_description: We joined the opening of the new facilities at our city hospital. A commitment to the well-being of the community where we began.
og_title: New intensive care units at the Las Parejas Hospital
og_description: A commitment to the well-being of the community where we began.
lead: We joined the opening of the new facilities at our city hospital. A commitment to the well-being of the community where we began.
body_paragraphs: We joined the opening of the new intensive care units at the Las Parejas Hospital, a project that improves medical care in our city and the surrounding area.
As a family company, our commitment goes beyond the factory: we want Las Parejas to keep growing, with better services for the people who live here.
We will keep doing our part for the community where we began, just as we work to make sure every seeder supports producers across the country.

Expoagro, AgroActiva, La Rural and Aapresid were some of the year's stops, with the full lineup showing its work in the field.
If you are planning your visit to an upcoming show, write to us and we will arrange a meeting with our sales team.

hero_image_alt: Front view of a Super Walter seeder over a field
lead: We were at the largest field show in the country, presenting the full lineup and talking with producers from every region.
body_paragraphs: We were at the largest field show in the country, presenting the full lineup and talking with producers from every region.
The full lineup, led by the W1770 Triflex, was on display throughout the days of the show.
Thank you to all the producers who stopped by the booth to see the machines up close.

Another chance to talk face to face with producers and technicians from different farming regions.

The Aapresid congress brings together leaders in no-till seeding from across the country every year, and in 2024 it was the stage chosen to present Lionel Scaloni as the new face of Super Walter.
Innovation, commitment and closeness to the producer: the same values we put into every seeder that leaves our plant.
